    StartersMORA command centre loaded potato skinsCrisp potato skins with cheddar, bacon, sour cream and chilli honeyHow to make it6 medium potatoes30g butter, melted150g cheddar, grated4 rashers of bacon, cooked and chopped150g sour cream2 spring onions, sliced1 jar pickled jalapenos2 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakesPrick the potatoes and bake at 200°C until tender.Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter and salt.Bake skin-side up, then flip.Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake until melted.Top with sour cream, spring onion and jalapenos, and drizzle with honey mixed with chilli flakes.Maple pecan pretzel crunchMaple roasted pecans, almonds and pretzels with chocolate and cranberriesHow to make it150g pecans100g almonds3 tbsp maple syrup1 tsp ground cinnamon100g mini pretzels100g dark chocolate, chopped80g dried cranberriesToss the pecans and almonds with the maple syrup, cinnamon and a pinch of salt.Spread on a lined tray with the pretzels and roast at 170°C, stirring once.Cool completely so the glaze crisps.Toss with the chocolate and cranberries and tip into a big bowl.MainsRed One's training day steak plateGrilled rump, parsley chimichurri, sweet potato wedges, broccoliniHow to make it2 large sweet potatoes, cut into wedges2 tbsp vegetable oil1 tsp smoked paprika1 bunch parsley2 garlic cloves1/2 tsp chilli flakes3 tbsp red wine vinegar100ml olive oil800g rump steak2 bunches of broccoliniToss the sweet potato with the oil, paprika and salt and roast at 220°C.Blitz the parsley, garlic, chilli, vinegar and olive oil into chimichurri.Season the steak and grill over high heat, then rest and slice.Grill the broccolini.Spoon the chimichurri over the steak and serve with the wedges and broccolini.Command canteen roast Stir the flour into the pan juices, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.Slice the turkey and serve with the potatoes, gravy and cranberry sauce.SweetsCode Red velvet crinkle cookiesRed cocoa cookies with white chocolate, rolled in icing sugarHow to make it115g butter, soft150g caster sugar1 egg1 tbsp full cream milk1 tsp vanilla extract1 tube red food colouring paste200g plain flour2 tbsp cocoa powder1 tsp baking powder100g white chocolate, chopped60g icing sugarBeat the butter and sugar, then add the egg, milk, vanilla and red colouring.Mix in the flour, cocoa, baking powder and a pinch of salt, then fold in the white chocolate.Chill the dough.Roll into balls, roll each in icing sugar and bake at 180°C.Cool on the tray.DrinksCallum Drift's spiced hot cocoaHot chocolate with cinnamon, brown sugar and a pinch of chilliHow to make it1 L full cream milk2 tbsp brown sugar1 cinnamon stick1 pinch chilli powder120g dark chocolate, chopped (plus a little to grate)50g milk chocolate, chopped1 tsp vanilla extract150ml thickened cream, whippedHeat the milk with the sugar, cinnamon and chilli until steaming.Remove the cinnamon and whisk in the chocolates and vanilla until smooth and frothy.Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream and a little grated chocolate.
